title: Battleaxe leg minimum width 3.6 m
text: A battleaxe leg is to be a minimum width of 3.6m, inclusive of a minimum: i. 3m wide driveway in accordance with C3.7.3; and ii. 0.3m setback either side of the driveway (refer Figure 3.7e).

replaces.note: Part C C3.7.10-C3.7.12; new deemed exempt for R40 and below (Part B relied on subdivision policy)

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 2 - Single Houses.pdf

notes: 3 m driveway is C3.7.3(i); the 0.3 m margins either side are not separately tested. Figure 3.7e is titled 'Communal street width' and shows the street setback to a communal street (Table 3.3a). Merit M3.7.3 allows a reduced leg where retaining an existing dwelling.
